description: T2 SDeformedVolumeChannel sign-flip probe. With 𝔙₄₁ made concrete (Lean FigureEightComplexVolume), test S = Im 𝔙₄₁(u(q₀)) vs the measured flip S(muon)>0>S(proton). Rigorous A-polynomial fact τ=−i√3 ⇒ a₂ purely imaginary ⇒ Im𝔙₄₁ = κ(Re²u−Im²u) (κ=√3/4), vanishing on the diagonals |Re u|=|Im u|, NOT the axes — correcting the heuristic √3·Re·Im form the #3773 F3 survivor was built on. Verdict structural-partial: F3 refuted against the corrected form (scope-(b), even-in-d), channel not excluded but requires a diagonal-crossing u(q₀). No fit; no u-map wired; no instance fabricated; no c_k.

data.scope_b_subresult: F3 family (one component linear-through-zero at q*, other anchor-constant) cannot sign-flip against Im𝔙=κ(Re²u−Im²u); invariant = a₂ purely imaginary (τ=−i√3).
data.channel_status: not excluded; requires u(q₀) crossing the diagonal |Re u|=|Im u| between anchors (Re²u−Im²u: +ve muon, −ve proton). Map OPEN.
data.correction: heuristic Im𝔙≈√3·Re·Im (qbeta_udeform_map_constraint_probe.py, qbeta_c3_barodd_gluing_newton_solve.py) is WRONG (implies real a₂); rigorous A-poly form is κ(Re²u−Im²u).

assertions.name: imV_vanishes_on_diagonal_not_axis
assertions.source: Im 𝔙₄₁(Re u = Im u) = 0 (harmonic quadratic form Re(u²))

assertions.name: F3_family_cannot_signflip_against_corrected_form

assertions.source: Re²u−Im²u = S/κ: +ve at muon, −ve at proton ⇒ u crosses |Re u|=|Im u| between anchors (channel not scope-(b) excluded)
